faq.item.valor.a: From R$ 13,000, with a 4-night minimum. The final price and availability are confirmed on WhatsApp.
faq.item.pessoas.q: How many people does the house host?
faq.item.pessoas.a: Up to 25 guests, in 10 suites with 13 bathrooms.
faq.item.horarios.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.item.horarios.a: Check-in at 12 pm and check-out at 12 pm.
faq.item.cobrancas.q: What is charged besides the daily rate?
faq.item.cobrancas.a: Water, electricity and gas, by use, and a refundable PIX deposit.
faq.item.equipe.a: Yes, as a paid option: cook, housekeeper and bartender, in a team of 3 to 5 people. Daily rates from R$ 270 to R$ 320, depending on the role.
faq.item.reserva.a: Direct on WhatsApp, or through Airbnb and VRBO.
faq.item.praia.q: Is the house close to the beach and the village?
faq.item.praia.a: It faces Tivoli Beach, 1 minute on foot. Praia do Forte village is 5 minutes on foot and Projeto Tamar 15. Salvador Airport is 1 hour by car.
faq.item.estacionamento.a: Yes, private, for 12 cars, 6 of them covered.
faq.item.seguranca.a: Yes, 24 hours, with two pedestrian gates leading to the village.
